name: Netlify Free

free_tier.notes: Hard limit; no overage purchase or auto-recharge on Free. Credits are the single metered currency for all usage.

free_tier.limit: 20 credits per GB (~15 GB/month if used only on bandwidth)
15 credits per production deploy (~20 deploys/month if used only on deploys)
free_tier.notes: Deploy Previews and branch deploys are free (0 credits)
Serverless functions/compute billed from the credit pool

free_tier.limit: 180 credits per USD of AI model usage

free_tier.notes: 1 team owner; team members not available on Free

notes: Perpetual free tier, but Netlify replaced its legacy fixed-quota Free plan (100 GB bandwidth / 300 build minutes) with a credit-based model (300 credits/month, further updated April 2026). Major gotcha: when the 300 monthly credits are exhausted, ALL web projects on the team are paused and visitors see a 'Site not available' page until the next monthly cycle; Free plan cannot buy extra credits. 300 credits also means only ~20 production deploys/month if credits go solely to deploys. Custom domains + SSL, unlimited deploy previews, and unlimited form submissions remain free. Paid credit-based plans (Personal/Pro) require a card on file; Free does not.
